mensaje_usuario: what shipping options do you have?
respuesta: You can choose between standard delivery, which takes 5 to 7 business days, and express delivery, which takes 2 to 3 business days. You'll see both options at checkout.

conversacion: C02 Opciones y tiempos de envío
mensaje_usuario: how long does express delivery take
respuesta: Standard orders usually arrive in 5 to 7 business days, and express orders in 2 to 3 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

mensaje_usuario: what is your refund policy?
respuesta: You can return any item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as it's unworn and has its tags.

mensaje_usuario: I want a refund for my blue dress
respuesta: To request a refund, go to 'My orders' at www.ourstore.com, select the order and click 'Return item'. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed in 5 to 10 business days.

mensaje_usuario: how can I track my refund?

mensaje_usuario: I'd like to create an account

mensaje_usuario: I forgot my password
respuesta: Let's get you back in. Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page at www.ourstore.com and check your inbox for the reset link. If you don't see it, take a look at your spam folder.

mensaje_usuario: how do I update my profile?
respuesta: Sure thing! Sign in at www.ourstore.com, go to 'My account' and click 'Edit profile' to update your details. Don't forget to save your changes.

mensaje_usuario: which payment methods do you accept?
respuesta: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.

respuesta: To add a shipping address, sign in at www.ourstore.com, go to 'My account' > 'Addresses' and click 'Add new address'.
